label: Поднять
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for поднять (to lift, to raise, perfective).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person. 'Подниму' uses the irregular подним- stem; perfective поднять has future meaning in its simple form. The imperfective partner is поднимать.

missions.phrase: Ты поднимешь руку, если знаешь ответ.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person. 'Поднимешь' keeps the подним- stem with the -ешь ending. 'Руку' is the accusative object of the single completed gesture.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person. 'Поднимет' is the он-form ending in -ет. 'Упавшую книгу' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Поднимем' shows the мы-ending -ем on the подним- stem. 'Флаг' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Поднимут' closes the future paradigm with the -ут ending. 'Поднять вопрос' is the idiom to raise an issue.
Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Поднял' is the masculine singular past of perfective поднять. The aspect marks one completed lift; 'тяжёлую сумку' is accusative.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Подняла' adds the feminine -а ending. 'Поднять глаза' is the idiom to look up; 'глаза' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Подняли' is the plural past ending in -и. 'Краном' is instrumental, the means by which the load was raised.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Подними' is the informal command of perfective поднять. 'Голову' is the accusative object of one decisive action.
Strategic focus: Infinitive after a verb. 'Помоги' governs the bare infinitive 'поднять'. The perfective infinitive points to one completed lifting; 'этот стол' is accusative.
